notes.title: Settlement Odyssey – New Buildings & Progress Update!
notes.content:
We've been hard at work expanding Settlement Odyssey, and we're excited to showcase some of the latest structures that will shape your settlements!

🌿 Fishing Hut – A key structure for gathering food from the waters, ensuring your settlers stay well-fed.
[img]https://scontent-atl3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.30808-6/483528176_2853566158155056_3780553532042116208_n.jpg?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=127cfc&_nc_ohc=mNZOucOzTeYQ7kNvgHklvwQ&_nc_oc=AdjMQsrcnWufNm6E_Tn0s4gUIg5MmquGaIhyESz6w9vNKNnUT4o1OGeEdjpHytvlEIO1PGmypx2ej-v__pwfsx8w&_nc_zt=23&_nc_ht=scontent-atl3-1.xx&_nc_gid=Aiwtcakd3utGTYx-Kn_dcEY&oh=00_AYEYUXOpJHWEzxk4eZZVzGH_9_KtrCVO1hEL1yQbypMvjg&oe=67D3DB47[/img]
⚕️ Medical Hut – Provides care for injured villagers, keeping your settlement healthy and thriving.
[img]https://scontent-atl3-2.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.30808-6/483486793_2853566144821724_3991657794151083059_n.jpg?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=127cfc&_nc_ohc=c89xP3tIhBYQ7kNvgEtqXAr&_nc_oc=Adhc6uZMyVHvx7H460-w5Sl6EA3J5ZCgADfLUYql-ZRg88tfKeR1kfba4Fz8lHawNw8alYJAhHhfKQovS0XDrwBX&_nc_zt=23&_nc_ht=scontent-atl3-2.xx&_nc_gid=A7VbxR_O3ApA02AdXSC63Qk&oh=00_AYF2yO1dxZXatWRPgcIauYpdTqelJg4LroxjuXoZkFxJqg&oe=67D3B33F[/img]
🔔 Town Center – The heart of the settlement where leadership and progress come together.
[img]https://scontent-atl3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.30808-6/482261217_2853566131488392_6501510846319972463_n.jpg?_nc_cat=110&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=127cfc&_nc_ohc=NIuu0P97RfwQ7kNvgGWi3WH&_nc_oc=AdhuvUGFj6DArqLNUPIFgbzJ4jauQc2v7wkX8cmipboPkiZh4gIPel8QpZDwQ6D_trp7FmDJe07LFcpSzVo0gsJA&_nc_zt=23&_nc_ht=scontent-atl3-1.xx&_nc_gid=AgRVIRjLa4xoG1Bz3pHmMXu&oh=00_AYHri0kPgOnMgbcr13taER33R2V7DfGkI_HJibwAZS4bPw&oe=67D3E71E[/img]
💧 Well – A crucial water source for your people, ensuring survival and sustainability.
[img]https://scontent-atl3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.30808-6/483698633_2853566194821719_3925569226841318285_n.jpg?_nc_cat=110&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=127cfc&_nc_ohc=NC_VEer0a4IQ7kNvgHFDj97&_nc_oc=AdjScKkwdY6_KP-guJUu_naCOjx8JtPMshr475YcR4iITHjduoPblsJNcTFSHSr1nFXjHfWceBklazbi8aE38aK8&_nc_zt=23&_nc_ht=scontent-atl3-1.xx&_nc_gid=A-eEYBXMCuahZa-7IEhxVEJ&oh=00_AYGe0UbVKNH6A-1JTU5BEiGuzMSkkKgCLOMN8mneWzHnbw&oe=67D3B2AA[/img]
🏰 Watch Tower – A strategic structure to keep an eye on the surroundings and protect the village.
[img]https://scontent-atl3-2.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.30808-6/483665470_2853566228155049_9001675789293938012_n.jpg?_nc_cat=101&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=127cfc&_nc_ohc=sWy-1zBySGcQ7kNvgEUuAlC&_nc_oc=Adi-3GrNLCN89sqGF9PoZK-cVvABvbj7W7jXyOYJCllHvK_XEn816BhmEjH0qWrHMR7KuOo40R0O3L4g5FnEfWmH&_nc_zt=23&_nc_ht=scontent-atl3-2.xx&_nc_gid=Aydm3_0HF1L-fizr6caJx2s&oh=00_AYE4-aeAxh3fjYfL8_r-zZUzU5WN4WQ-KSY5EThqqshj0g&oe=67D3CB77[/img]
🌾 Windmill – Essential for processing grains and supporting your food supply.
[img]https://scontent-atl3-2.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.30808-6/482250647_2853566238155048_1150101748122629337_n.jpg?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=127cfc&_nc_ohc=yFcX5GBxnDkQ7kNvgEnLE5Y&_nc_oc=Adi3ZUd0hiSYuYERBIdQKz62w5hdSREVyHdKJsc2s-62Ky83rBGwj5L-NHwROudaCmyX8gqkQoXsVq2_wY_6jS5I&_nc_zt=23&_nc_ht=scontent-atl3-2.xx&_nc_gid=AhPMCcR70wx7gers42BjJCL&oh=00_AYFe8QGZss-kFGeZgjVsuP7hF5zoKYKC8TOpU1Xzpmh2cg&oe=67D3CE4A[/img]

We've also made significant progress behind the scenes with core game functionality, improving the way settlers interact, gather resources, and manage their daily lives. Plus, we've developed a variety of small houses to give your village even more diversity and charm!

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue shaping Settlement Odyssey!
